crossRefs.note: “ ‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be…
if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without…
“Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…

translations.web: “ ‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
translations.bsb: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.
translations.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
translations.asv: And if one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a she-goat a year old for a sin-offering.
